verified: Manual check bypasses WAF wait but still validates merchant authorization and every pinned product inventory.
Failed checks do not resume, claim, start a batch, or upload; successful verification is the prerequisite to resume.
Manual file, protected persisted pauses, disabled backend, unknown inventory and uncertain batches remain protected.
Lost ACK replays the saved success/failure without another merchant scan, including after session loss on restart.
Invalid request/device/state/ID fails closed without ACK or merchant verification.
Paused daemon polls local recheck every 5 seconds while normal work remains at 60 seconds; manual request triggers before next normal cycle.
Worker lock releases after every poll and exception; scheduler lock remains held until daemon exit.
Installing daemon while paused preserves state.json and manual pause file.
